about: 2.84 Trend Rider v1, the option-buying setup (Mandeep, 22 Nov 2026: 'ek achhi option buying ka set-up banana hai'; plan: the project doc claude/buying_setup_plan.md). Every index and F&O stock, 1 lot, sized by the capital chosen in the app. On trial (registry 'trend_rider', shadow): recorded, graded and paper-tested on the test bench only; nothing you see or trade changes until Mandeep switches it on. windows: minutes since 09:15 at the bar's close (5-60 = 09:20-10:15, 120-240 = 11:15-13:15). Starting numbers from the 5-19 Nov bench data and the research in the plan; the Lab tunes them.
ema_videos_about: 2.89 (Mandeep, 22 Nov 2026: 'saare factors ke sath ye bhi include karo jo transcript me hai'): the two videos he sent on 13 Nov, rules copied from Tanu 0.11 / 0.12. 5 EMA alert: a candle closing above the 5 EMA with its low off it, the next candle breaks its low = put (stop: its high), on 5-min candles (tf_bars.down 1); the mirror on 15-min candles for calls (tf_bars.up 3). 10 EMA pullback: above the 10 EMA a red candle off the EMA, the next candle breaks its high = call (stop: the EMA); the mirror for puts. They form a sixth agreement family 'ema' (fired in that direction within recent_bars bars). On trial: computed, recorded, on the chart and the reading card; count_in_agreement and as_trigger stay false (the decision is exactly 2.84's) until the Lab test (variants ema:, trig:, _t10) wins on the holdout and Mandeep says so. Tanu's research 0004 / 0005 on 524 days of real option prices: on their own both lost after costs (5 EMA puts -137, calls -276, 10 EMA -229 a trade).
confidence_about: 2.90 (Mandeep, 22 Nov 2026: 'ek hi time par ghanshyam wale points bhi check kiye live market or chart mein or ye bhi check kiya or sab milake confidence or strong kiya'): one score 0-100 per direction from every factor at the same closed bar: Trend Rider's own checks (breakout, trend day, the families incl. the EMA videos, chase, move vs decay, tradability, strength vs Nifty) and what only the live engine knows: Ghanshyam's points (his strategy file, Nifty / Bank Nifty), the other named strategies (library, books, strategy files, fusions) that fired on the symbol in the last 15 minutes, MindGame's buyer / seller lean (5-min) and the candle forecast. Each votes with / against / neutral / no view; score = 50 + 50 x weighted net vote / weights with a view (50 = as much for as against). min 75 / strong 85: a signal that passes Trend Rider's own checks already scores about 75-90 (19 Nov replay: 77 / 82 / 89 at the 10th / 50th / 90th percentile), so these split the signals that pass; the outside votes (Ghanshyam, strategies, MindGame, forecast) move them. On trial: shown on the chart, the card and the alert, recorded with every signal; use_in_decision stays false until high-confidence signals beat low ones on the graded record and Mandeep says so.
exit_about: 2.85 exit (lab/rider_exit.py), on 5-minute closes of the index / stock, never on a wick: first stop beyond the broken level + stop.buffer_atr; at lock_r x risk the stop moves to entry + lock_buffer_atr ATR (1 lot: locking is the booking); then a trail trail_loose_atr ATRs behind the best price, tightened to trail_tight_atr only when reversal_signs_for_tight reversal signs show (rejection candle, two closes against, a close beyond the previous bar's far end); out if after nomove_bars closes the move is under nomove_progress_atr ATR and the option is not above entry; emergency stop on the premium at -emergency_premium_pct % on any tick; out at exit_hhmm. cooldown_min 15 with max_signals_per_symbol_day 2: the second signal of a day is the re-entry after a stop.
